payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: Redemption payouts delayed

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.99 · **Written by:** baseline agent

## Summary
Redemption payouts for the 10:00 IST batch (PB-1021-AM) were delayed because an ongoing database migration (ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '') initiated at 04:26:00.000Z held an exclusive lock on the payout_instructions table. This blocked all insert/update operations from the payout-service and caused monitoring/dashboard queries to hang or time out.

**Root cause:** A database schema migration (CHG-48223, ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '') started at 2026-10-21 04:26:00.000Z, holding an exclusive lock on the payout_instructions table. This blocked the 10:00 IST payout batch (PB-1021-AM) and associated dashboard queries from accessing the table, resulting in zero payouts processed and dashboard timeouts.

## Hypotheses
1. **Database table lock contention caused by an ongoing ALTER TABLE migration on payout_instructions blocking payout-service transactions and monitoring queries.** — `database`, config_change, confidence 0.99, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_2, ev_3, ev_8] · Contradicting: none
   - Directly evidenced by database and service logs showing process 48213 blocking all access to payout_instructions during the 10:00 IST payout batch.
2. **Partner bank API outage preventing payout requests from completing.** — `bank-apis`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.01, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_1, ev_2]
   - Ruled out because initial payout requests succeeded before hitting table lock waits, and logs confirm database table locking is the root bottleneck.

## Facts
- Schema migration CHG-48223 (ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '') started at 2026-10-21 04:26:00.000Z. [ev_3]
- Payout batch PB-1021-AM started at 2026-10-21 04:30:06.000Z with 2,412 redemptions queued. [ev_1]
- Database logs show multiple processes waiting for RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions, blocked by process 48213 running the ALTER TABLE migration. [ev_2, ev_8]
- Batch PB-1021-AM reported lock wait exceeded 1800s and 3600s with 0 of 2412 payouts sent. [ev_1, ev_2]

## Inferences
- Payout dashboards failed to load because UI and metric queries waiting on database connections or table locks on payout_instructions timed out. [ev_1, ev_2]

## Assumptions
- Dashboards failed to load due to queries timing out waiting for database table locks on payout_instructions.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-21T04:26:00.000Z** Schema migration CHG-48223 started: ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' [ev_3]
- **2026-10-21T04:30:06.000Z** Payout batch PB-1021-AM started with 2,412 redemptions queued [ev_1]
- **2026-10-21T04:31:56.146Z** Database logs first lock wait warning for payout_instructions blocked by migration process 48213 [ev_2]
- **2026-10-21T05:00:00.000Z** Payout batch reports lock wait exceeded 1800s; 0 of 2412 payouts sent [ev_1]

## Confidence
0.99: Database logs and payout service logs directly show the ALTER TABLE migration holding an exclusive lock on payout_instructions, blocking all payout processing and causing lock wait timeouts.

## Gaps
- Exact completion time of migration process 48213 after the investigation window. (impact: Low; the blockage persisted throughout the investigation window.)

## Tool failures

- query_metrics {"service":"payout-service","metric":"batch_duration_s","from":"2026-10-21T04:00:00.000Z","to":"2026-10-21T06:45:00.000Z","resolution":"1m","aggregation":"avg"}: timeout: query_metrics did not respond within 1500 ms (after 3 attempts) (3 attempts)
- query_metrics {"service":"payout-service","metric":"payouts_pending","from":"2026-10-21T04:00:00.000Z","to":"2026-10-21T06:45:00.000Z","resolution":"1m","aggregation":"avg"}: timeout: query_metrics did not respond within 1500 ms (after 3 attempts) (3 attempts)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Terminate or roll back database migration process 48213 to release the table lock on payout_instructions. [ev_2, ev_3]
  - Why: Unblocking the table is required for payout-service to process transactions and dashboards to load.
  - Verify: Check database active processes and verify payout-service logs show successful queries without lock wait warnings.
- **[now]** Resume or retry payout batch PB-1021-AM after the lock is released. [ev_1, ev_2]
  - Why: Ensures the 2,412 affected users receive their redemption payouts.
  - Verify: Confirm payout-service processes all 2,412 queued payouts and completes the batch.
- **[next]** Refactor database migration practices to avoid locking production tables during peak windows (e.g. adding nullable columns first without DEFAULT, then backfilling). [ev_3]
  - Why: Prevents future production incidents caused by schema migrations locking high-traffic tables.
  - Verify: Review deployment runbooks and migration guidelines.
